name: delinquency_by_property
description: Total delinquent amount and number of delinquent charges per property (Delinquency report grouped by property).
answer_hint: Defaults: balance over $100, more than 5 days late, current tenants + prospects, all charge types.

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

balance_over.description: only accounts owing MORE than this amount (100 = over $100)

days_late_over.description: only accounts MORE than this many days late (5 = more than 5 days)

headline: {sum$:Owed} delinquent across {count} property(ies) as of {as_of}; highest: {top1:Property} ({top1$:Owed}).
